import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Initialize AFM
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
app = spm.application

opmode = app.OperatingMode

scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # meters
scan.Points = 128
scan.Lines = 128

# Wait for the scan to finish (add a small safety margin)

# Locate the most recent image file saved by the AFM software
workspace = r"C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\corral\corral\tasks\afm\src\afm\gpt_oss_subtask_2_tool_calling\enviroment\subtasks_2"

application = spm.application

print("Scanning finished")
del spm

import nanosurf, time, os, sys

# Directory where images are saved (assume current working directory contains images)
image_dir = r'C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\corral\corral\tasks\afm\src\afm\gpt_oss_subtask_2_tool_calling\enviroment\subtasks_2'

# Get initial set of tif files
initial = set(f for f in os.listdir(image_dir) if f.lower().endswith('.tif'))

spm = nanosurf.SPM()
app = spm.application
scan = app.Scan
opmode = app.OperatingMode

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6
scan.Points = 128
scan.Lines = 128
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # seconds per line
# Set tapping mode (PhaseContrast)
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.PhaseContrast

# Start scan
scan.StartFrameUp()
while scan.IsScanning:
    time.sleep(1)

# Cleanup
del spm

# Get final set of tif files
final = set(f for f in os.listdir(image_dir) if f.lower().endswith('.tif'))
new_files = final - initial
if new_files:
    for f in new_files:
        print(os.path.join(image_dir, f))
else:
    print('No new image file detected')

    except Exception:
        pass

    time.sleep(2)

]

        files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(p, '*.*')), key=os.path.getmtime, reverse=True)
        if files:
            image_path = files[0]

{"code": "import nanosurf, time, os, json, traceback

try:
    spm = nanosurf.SPM()
    app = spm.application
    scan = app.Scan
    opmode = app.OperatingMode
    # set filename mask for saved image
    filename_mask = "scan_image_10x10um"
    try:
        app.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(filename_mask)
    except Exception as e:
        print('SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask error:', e)
    # configure scan parameters
    scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6
    scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6
    scan.Points = 128
    scan.Lines = 128
    scan.Scantime = 0.4
    # set mode to tapping if possible
    try:
        opmode.Mode = "Tapping"
    except Exception as e:
        print('Set mode string error:', e)
        try:
            opmode.Mode = 2
        except Exception as e2:
            print('Set mode numeric error:', e2)
    # start scan
    print('Starting scan...')
    scan.StartFrameUp()
    # wait for scan to finish (approx 60s)
    time.sleep(65)
    print('Scan finished')
    # after scan, list files in current directory
    cwd = os.getcwd()
    print('Current working dir:', cwd)
    files = [f for f in os.listdir(cwd) if f.startswith(filename_mask)]
    print('Files matching mask:', files)
    # also list all tif files
    all_tif = [f for f in os.listdir(cwd) if f.lower().endswith('.tif')]
    print('All tif files:', all_tif)
except Exception as e:
    print('Error:', e)
    traceback.print_exc()
finally:
    try:
        del spm
    except Exception:
        pass
"}

try:
    spm = nanosurf.SPM()
    app = spm.application
    scan = app.Scan
    opmode = app.OperatingMode
    # set scan parameters
    scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6
    scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6
    scan.Points = 128
    scan.Lines = 128
    scan.Scantime = 0.4
    # set mode to tapping if possible
    try:
        opmode.Mode = "Tapping"
    except Exception as e:
        print('Setting Mode by string failed:', e)
        # try numeric value (assuming 2 is tapping)
        try:
            opmode.Mode = 2
        except Exception as e2:
            print('Setting Mode by numeric failed:', e2)

    print('Starting scan...')
    scan.StartFrameUp()
    # wait a bit longer than expected total time
    time.sleep(60)
    print('Scan completed')

    traceback.print_exc()
finally:
    try:
        del spm
    except Exception:
